column1: # Bingo Flashboard — single app + SPIFFS for UI + four voice pack.bin files.
# SPIFFS usable space is well below the partition size (metadata overhead) —
# keep a healthy margin (payload ~4.5 MiB → use ≥8–10 MiB partition).
# N16R8 16 MB flash: ~3 MB app + ~10 MB SPIFFS.
# After changing this map: erase flash once
